event.name: LIFE+
event.tagline: Living well at every stage of life.
event.intro: A one-day community event on healthy ageing with HIV. It's open to adults of every age: older adults living it now, younger adults planning ahead, and the caregivers and friends who support them. Join us for conversation, wellbeing check-ins, games, music, creative reflection and a shared lunch.
event.rsvpNote: RSVP only. Places are limited, so please sign up early.

event.quotes:
I want to grow older well, not just longer.
I don't want to face this alone.
What does getting older with HIV look like for me?
I want to start planning for my future now.
I still have so much life to live.
event.privacyNote: We will never ask about your HIV status. Your details are used only to organise LIFE+ and are seen only by the organising team.

line.label: the line of support
line.belowText: **Below the line.** Isolation, stigma, silence and worry can creep in as we grow older with HIV. They are common, and they are not your fault. Noticing them is the first step up.
line.aboveText: **Above the line.** Life, independence, fulfilment and empowerment. LIFE+ is a day to move up together, at your own pace, with people who understand.

objectives.title: Promote healthy ageing
objectives.text: Awareness of the physical, psychological and social needs of older adults with HIV.

objectives.title: Empower older adults
objectives.text: Space to share their perspectives, explore their wellbeing and find the right support.

objectives.title: Strengthen caregiving
objectives.text: Better understanding of ageing needs, emotional support and caregiver wellbeing.

objectives.title: Encourage holistic healthcare
objectives.text: Collaboration across medicine, nursing, psychology, counselling and community care.

objectives.title: Address stigma and isolation
objectives.text: Inclusive attitudes, meaningful social connection and dignity in ageing.

objectives.title: Build sustainable partnerships
objectives.text: Continued collaboration and future healthy ageing initiatives.

audiences.title: Adults living with HIV
audiences.text: The focus of the day. Older adults are at the heart of LIFE+, and younger adults are welcome to plan ahead for healthy ageing.

audiences.title: Caregivers, family and friends
audiences.text: Supporting someone living with HIV, and looking after themselves too.

audiences.title: Community organisations
audiences.text: Advocates in HIV, ageing, health promotion and community wellbeing.

stations.name: MOOD+
stations.text: Short one-to-one check-in on mood, stress and worry, with supervised counselling trainees.

stations.name: MEMORY+
stations.text: Quick memory and thinking check, one-to-one, with trained health students.

stations.name: MOVE+
stations.text: Seated dance, joget and stretching to golden-oldies music. Rest breaks any time.

stations.name: PLAY+
stations.text: Bingo, congkak, dam haji, carrom and word games, with small prizes. Large print, no rush.

stations.name: CONNECT+
stations.text: Conversation cards, partner activities and shared stories. Speak, write, point or just listen.

schedule.title: Beyond the Diagnosis: interactive panel
schedule.detail: A clinician, a caregiver and a person ageing with HIV. Your questions shape the conversation.

schedule.title: LIFE+ Wellbeing Stations
schedule.detail: Private, optional mood and memory check-ins, plus seated dance, games and conversation.

schedule.title: My Life, My Story
schedule.detail: Draw, write or share what makes life meaningful, with no need to disclose HIV status.

schedule.title: Open stations: catch-up check-ins and games
Support Passport
schedule.detail: A booth trail with PT Foundation, clinics and community groups. Collect a stamp at each and leave with a personal support map.

schedule.title: My LIFE+ Wellbeing Plan
schedule.detail: A one-page worksheet: one next step each for body, feelings, connection and support. Private unless you choose to share.

schedule.title: Closing: Tree of Hopes and feedback
schedule.detail: Everyone adds a leaf with one hope. The finished tree becomes a shared artwork for PT Foundation's space.
